notes: I could not read the Roswell Park June 2026 agenda PDF. WebFetch returned only compressed PDF streams, and Read needs poppler, which isn't installed. Bash was disabled, so I couldn't extract the text locally. I did not reach the Sep 2026 Roswell Park agendas or the U. Illinois trustee docx series. The searches found no board or trustee agenda items. They surfaced federal sole-source notices and one Roswell Park state solicitation (seen only as a search-result snippet), which is a weak lead on a 6000 trade-in. I can't say whether the Roswell Park board item exists or what it contains.
how_to_mine: 1) Extract text from the saved June 2026 Roswell Park agenda PDF with pypdf or pdftotext, then grep for Illumina, sequenc, NovaSeq and 'Next Generation'. Do the same for the Sep 2026 agenda; guess the URL by changing 'june' to 'september' in the slug, or browse roswellpark.org/about-us/board-of-directors. 2) Open NY State Contract Reporter solicitation #26-164 (nyscr.ny.gov) and look for the award notice or an updated Q&A, which should name the winning OEM, the NovaSeq 6000 trade-in credit and the 5-year consumable price schedule. 3) Browse trustees.uillinois.edu/trustees/agenda/ for 'Purchases and renewals' docx files from 2025-26 and grep for Illumina or NovaSeq. 4) Search other public boards for 'NovaSeq X' with 'trade-in', for example UT System, UC Regents, Texas A&M and county hospital boards.

items.label: 1A
items.claim: Roswell Park Cancer Center's March 2026 NGS solicitation asks bidders about trading in an existing NovaSeq 6000, an institutional 6000-to-X replacement signal.
items.detail: The NY State Contract Reporter notice #26-164 was posted 24 Mar 2026 with responses due 14 Apr 2026. It covers ultra-high-throughput NGS for the Genomics Shared Resource and Advanced Molecular Diagnostics. It requests 5-year consumable and maintenance pricing and mentions a possible NovaSeq 6000 trade-in. I saw this only in a search-result summary, and I did not open the notice. The award, the price and the sequencer model are unknown.
items.source_name: NY State Contract Reporter (via search snippet)
items.why_new: Roswell Park's solicitation and its 6000 trade-in clause are not in the known list, which does cover other 6000 retirements.
